Report by IPI on 2 recent polio-related incidents, as requested:

Note: 1PI research began as usual, right alter these incidents were reported In the Pak focal media, IPIY data-base Is kept updated on all such inaden&...
51) Mob Baluchistan: Zhob is of goo-strategic importance for the Taliban (both TTPakistan & TTAfghanistan) as it shares a border with South Waziristan. Dera Ismail Khan (&
other trouble NIO: S I as well as Afghanistan - & connects Baluchistan with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa & Punjab: Zhob is also important as a major landroute for goods transport between
KP & Karachi port. Zhob Airport was used by NATO 2009-2011. The border arca is protected by Pakistan's paramilitary Frontier Corps. Zhob is an important passageway for
militants, smugglers & Afghan refugees. There are a number of TTP"camps" in Zhob. with large caches of amens. ammunition, explosives. Hence for a number of years, security
fortes have canyied out repeated operations in the area (including helicopters), leading to increased kidnappings & terror anions by militant groups to protect their camps including
attacks on Levies checkposts especially in Murtha Kibzai. This makes fob a no-go + high-risk arca. The polio-related kidnapping was most recently preceded by the kidnapping
of six Pak Telecommunication Co. staff(including 2 engineers, all still missing). The most important political party in the Zhob area is the religion-based Jamiat Ulema c Islam
(QUI). The important militant groups in Zhob
TTP & some of its splinter groups; Jundallah - a militant group dating to pre-Taliban days. which has in recent years shown
renewed terror activity: Jundallah claimed the 26 Nov 2012 attack (when it attacked a polio team in Eastern Bypass arca of Quails. killing 4 polio workers) & has in the past 12
months allied itself with other militat groups such as TTP & splinters, as well as the anti-shiitc Lashkar Jhangvi.

Polio Incident: On Friday 13 February 2015 ca. 23:00. the polio team (3 polio workers & 2 accompanying Levies) was last in contact, on their way back. Pak security
forces launched a search/rescue operation (ca. 250 FC) in Toda KibrairMurgha Ritual area: during an exchange of Bre. two suicide bombers blew thentsehes up on
Sunday 15 Feb pm - the I" suicide bombing in connection with polio! Four bodies & the polio ambulance were recovered (3 so far identified: 1 ambulance driver & 2
Levies). The fate of the still-missing markers is not yet known. the militants switch locations to mold detection. 1P1 is following up. The Balochistan Provincial Cost has
postponed PEP In Quetta. Zhob. Sherani & Sibi districts.

Refusals: PEP refusals are related to parental refusal which pre-dates the Taliban ban.

IPI recommendation: As requested.

In view of the inter-related context as above, attacks by militants (whether shooting, kidnapping or other) is part of the strategy by militants, especially TTP, to attack security forces
- it is not a new tactic. It pit-dates the Zarb Anb military operation begun in June 2014. but now, in response, all uniformed personnel, anywhere in Pakistan, are renewed targets
of the TTP & its allies. The police and/or Levies accompanying polio teams offer the right target & polio workers arc collateral damage, sometimes in gunfire by the security
forces.

Since the December 2014 suicide operation on the Army Public School in Peshawar. a true game-changer, members of TIP. Lashkar Jhangvi. Jundallah & allies are being hanged
by the authorities -. hence any chance of a dialogue with any of the militant groups cited above is. for the present, neither possible nor recommended.
